column8:
Every time you go into Primal State you give one point in Humanity.

When distressed - you can go into Primal State (regain all health, cure status conditions, restore reductions to attributes and ignore pain penalties) allows you to add extra dice to all actions equal to your instinct score.

You'll be feral until you're safe or the scene is safe.

If you faint in this state you will gain a Primal Point (negative Humanity point) and lose one Will permanently.
